---
title: "GIAMIP"
---

The Glacial Isostatic Adjustment Model Intercomparison Project. Unlike the two
benchmarks, this one is open: there is no reference answer, and the point is
to measure the spread between models.

Lead: Holly Han. Associate and technical lead: Jan Swierczek-Jereczek.
Endorsed by PALSEA-Next, with the output archive supported by ISMIP7.

The protocol as supplied is [reproduced here](../protocol/giamip-v4.0.qmd).

## Experiments

Five mandatory, seven optional. A field marked `open` is the group's choice
and has to be recorded in the model report. A value in red is the choice the
G-ADOPT team made for its own runs, in a field the protocol leaves open. The
"Open choices" column counts the fields that the protocol leaves open. The
[protocol page](../protocol/giamip-v4.0.qmd) explains the G-ADOPT choices.

```{python}
#| echo: false
# The table is built by docs/_experiments.py, which the protocol and results
# pages also use, so the three tables cannot disagree.
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("../..").resolve()))
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("..").resolve()))
from IPython.display import Markdown
import _experiments
Markdown(_experiments.id_table(link=True, open_count=True))
```

## Inputs

Six ice histories, two of them also in a shorter version, and three bed
topographies, all on the prescribed Gauss-Legendre grid of 257 latitudes by
513 longitudes. Only grounded ice loads the solid Earth; floating ice is
masked out.

The ice histories run from 122 ka before 2000 CE to 1000 years after it, in
463 steps, at 500 years before 26 ka and 100 years after. PaleoMIST starts at
80 ka and has 379 steps. For Exp06 and Exp07, ICE-6G_D and ICE-7G_NA also come
as `_80ka` files that start at 80 ka, with 379 steps. They equal the last 379
steps of the 122 ka files to within float32 rounding.

The three topographies differ only in their Antarctic source: BedMachine
Antarctica v3, Bedmap3 or Bedmap2, each merged with BedMachine Greenland v5.5
and GEBCO.

The elastic structure of every experiment that names PREM is PREM-stable
(protocol v4.0 Section 3.1). It is in this repository as
`giamip/PREM-stable.csv`, and [the earth models page](../reference/earth-models.qmd#prem-stable)
summarises it.

## Output

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("../..").resolve()))
from IPython.display import Markdown
import json, pathlib
v = json.loads((pathlib.Path("../..") / "giamip" / "resources"
                / "variables.json").read_text())
man = [e for e in v["variables"] if e["mandatory"]]
opt = [e for e in v["variables"] if not e["mandatory"]]
rows = [f"{len(man)} mandatory variables and {len(opt)} optional ones.\n",
        "| Variable | Required | Dimensions | Unit | Precision | Long name |",
        "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
for e in v["variables"]:
    rows.append(f"| `{e['variable']}` | {'yes' if e['mandatory'] else 'optional'} | "
                f"{e['dim']} | `{e['units']}` | {e['precision']} | {e['long_name']} |")
rows.append("")
rows.append(f"Filename pattern: `{v['filename_convention']['pattern']}`")
rows.append("")
rows.append("::: {.callout-warning}")
rows.append(v["filename_convention"]["constraint"])
rows.append(":::")
Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```

This list is generated from the compliance checker that protocol section 6.3
requires every submission to pass, and not retyped from the protocol prose,
which names only three of the fourteen. See `AGENTS.md` on where authority
lives.

## Two things that do not line up

**The GLAC3 version.** The protocol table says GLAC3b. The filenames say
`GLAC3c_profile`. The attributes inside the files say `GLAC3c_merge`. The
compliance checker expects a fourth spelling. On 2026-09-12, Holly Han, the
lead of the protocol, confirmed that the delivered files are the intended
inputs, and that each file combines GLAC3 versions a, b and c across the ice
sheets. The case files give the ice history as `GLAC3_p1` to `GLAC3_p3`, with
no version letter.

**Four experiments are open in every column.** Exp09 to Exp12 are not cases
until the earth structure is chosen.
